title: Tau
shortDescription: Your Tau coding workspace, connected to your phone.
fullDescription:
Follow your coding agents from your phone. Tau connects to the Tau desktop app running on your own computer.

Open your projects and threads, read agent responses, send follow-up instructions and respond to questions while away from your desk. Inspect project files and code changes in a layout made for a phone. Pair multiple Tau hosts and switch between them.

When your host has push notifications configured, Tau can notify you when work finishes or needs your attention.

Getting started
Install Tau on your computer from https://rasalas.github.io/tau/. Open Settings → Connections, create a pairing link and scan its QR code with the phone app. Approve the connection on your computer. Your phone must be able to reach that host over your network or your own remote-access setup.

Tau is a companion app. Real agent work runs on your computer and uses the AI providers you configure there. The Android app does not include AI credits or a hosted computer. Provider accounts and charges depend on your setup.

Privacy
Your workspace connects directly to your selected host. Optional push delivery uses Google Firebase Cloud Messaging; notification titles and, by default, short text excerpts pass through Google. You can adjust their content on the host. Tau has no advertising.

Tau is in active development. Support: tau@tbuck.de
